body:
## Pull request overview

This PR enhances the `examples/crm` metadata so CRM lookup fields demonstrate the enterprise RecordPicker capabilities (multi-column rendering, base filters, and description text) despite `ObjectSchema.create()` stripping non-spec properties.

**Changes:**
- Injects `lookup_columns`, `lookup_filters`, and `description_field` onto all CRM lookup fields via post-create `Object.assign()`.
- Adds enterprise lookup metadata tests in `examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts`.
- Updates `CHANGELOG.md` and `ROADMAP.md` to reflect the CRM example improvements.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 11 out of 11 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/src/objects/account.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `owner` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/contact.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `account` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/event.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `participants` and `organizer` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `account` and `contacts` lookup enterprise metadata (incl. `lookup_page_size`). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity_contact.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `opportunity` and `contact` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/order.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `customer` and `account` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/order_item.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `order` and `product` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/objects/project.object.ts | Adds post-create injection for `manager` and `assignee` lookup enterprise metadata. |
| examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts | Adds lookup metadata presence/diversity tests and compatibility checks for filter/operator/type mappings. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the CRM enterprise lookup metadata work as completed. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the new CRM enterprise lookup metadata and related tests. |
</details>

Similarly, `mapFieldTypeToFilterType` is duplicated here to match `LookupField.tsx`. This will become brittle if the production mapping changes. Consider importing a shared/exported mapping/helper from `@object-ui/fields` (or adding a small exported utility) so the test stays aligned with the actual filter bar generation logic.

The comment claims this metadata is "Preserved at runtime via defineStack({ strict: false })", but `defineStack` isn't used anywhere in the CRM example (only mentioned in these new comments). This is misleading—post-`ObjectSchema.create()` `Object.assign()` is what preserves the enterprise metadata here. Consider removing the `defineStack` mention or rewording to describe the actual runtime behavior in this repo.

The comment mentions preservation via `defineStack({ strict: false })`, but `defineStack` doesn't appear to be used anywhere in `examples/crm`. This makes the rationale confusing; the actual mechanism here is the post-create `Object.assign()` injection. Please reword/remove the `defineStack` reference.

The `defineStack({ strict: false })` callout here seems misleading since the CRM example doesn't use `defineStack` anywhere. The metadata persistence in this file comes from the post-create `Object.assign()` injection; please update the comment accordingly.

The comment suggests `defineStack({ strict: false })` is involved in preserving this injected metadata, but `defineStack` isn't used in `examples/crm`. Please reword/remove that part so the comment matches how the example actually works (post-create `Object.assign()` injection).

This comment references preservation via `defineStack({ strict: false })`, but the CRM example doesn't use `defineStack` anywhere (only referenced in these new comments). Please adjust wording to reflect that post-create `Object.assign()` is what keeps this enterprise metadata.

This comment says the injected metadata is "Preserved at runtime via defineStack({ strict: false })", but `defineStack` is not used in the CRM example—only referenced in these new comments. Please adjust the comment to avoid implying a dependency on `defineStack` when the persistence is due to the post-create `Object.assign()`.

The `defineStack({ strict: false })` mention here appears inaccurate/misleading: `examples/crm` doesn't use `defineStack` anywhere, and the preservation mechanism in this file is the post-create `Object.assign()` injection. Please reword/remove the `defineStack` reference for clarity.

This new comment references `defineStack({ strict: false })`, but there is no `defineStack` usage in `examples/crm` (only these comments). To avoid confusion, please rephrase to describe the actual reason the metadata survives (post-create `Object.assign()`).

These tests re-implement `lookupFiltersToRecord` inline to “mirror” RecordPickerDialog behavior. This duplicates production logic (and can drift over time), reducing the value of the test. Prefer asserting behavior through the actual widget/data-source call path, or extract/export a shared helper from `packages/fields` and import it here so there’s a single source of truth.
